run.machine: 4 vCPU x86_64, 15 GB RAM, no GPU (Claude Code cloud session)
run.server: llama-cpp-python 0.3.36 (llama.cpp), n_ctx 8192, n_threads 4, one request at a time
run.weights: Q4_K_M GGUF from Hugging Face (unsloth/*, Qwen/*), SHA-256 checked against the published LFS oid
run.decoding: temperature 0, JSON-schema-constrained: the client's response_format json_schema relayed as llama-cpp-python's json_object+schema (grammar), which is what Ollama does internally
run.assistant: explorer.assistant defaults: max-tables 5, max-columns-per-table 40, prompt-char-budget 12000, repair-rounds 1, request timeout 300 s
run.peakRssNote: VmHWM of the server process: weights (mmap), the 8192-token KV cache and the Python server
